description: Free comparison of two supplied unsigned payment challenges for the same resource and method. Exact EVM v1/v2 only. Shows changed amounts, recipients, assets and supported terms, with stable digests. Captures are caller declarations; no origin authentication, signatures, fetching or payment. Unknown profiles remain non-comparable.
